body:
First independently raised 2026-10-08 America/Los_Angeles by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`; earlier occurrences unknown.

Affected [PR #1329](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/1329), merge `e3765802ba8a683c706aff8e3440ac21bcddcf4e`, head `9aa7d9efd51cd9eb8d6eb1026af63badd5e11314`. Preserve closed original #1310 and all original source/vintage/geometry/identity and retained attempts. One bounded reporting-integrity remainder, at most two PRs, owns only the new disjoint namespace below. PR1329 remains Incomplete; this repair does not replace missing complete scientific verification.

Confirmed defects in the unchanged `summarize.py`: positive/negative receipts unconditionally say `outcome: passed`; several scientific metrics are hard-coded instead of derived and reconciled from the complete input; overwrite-capable output writes follow symlinks without whole-output-set admission. Two identical run files can therefore generate contradictory passed receipts/counts or writes outside the packet.

Actual reproduction in a managed detached exact-merge slot, without credentials: copy unchanged `summarize.py` and both complete retained `verification/run-1.json` and `run-2.json` into your own private packet mirror; invoke the actual script with Python3.12.14 and `-I`.

1. Intact positive fixture: exit0. All three CSVs, summary metrics and three typed receipts match the seven retained originals byte for byte.
2. In both complete run files set `controls.scope_roster.negative_omission_rejected` to false, maintaining byte equality. Exit0; emitted negative receipt has `outcome: passed` and its own `evidence.omission_rejected: false`.
3. In both complete run files replace every candidate's `official_2026_whole_layer_relations.exact_whole_feature_intersections` with an empty array. All48 candidates remain. Exit0; candidate CSV has no intersections/covers, but summary still reports42 intersections/8 covers/6 no-intersections. This tests inconsistent-input rejection/report binding; it does not assert the original scientific result has zero intersections.
4. With intact original runs, make `summary-metrics.json` a dangling symlink to an absent file in your own scratch outside the packet. Exit0; the outside target is created and passed receipts are published. Never target originals, another worker or production files.

The original final runs and `reproduce.py` also say in `methods.limits` that four candidate pointsets have no intersection. Independent derivation from all48 retained records gives six, matching README and summary. The `methods.completeness` sentence describes contacts as name leads rather than contact-boundary comparisons despite retained full source/current contact relations. Correct these through a bound additive erratum; never rewrite historical reports.

Success criteria:

- Preserve all21 original packet files, failed/superseded attempts, original source IDs/vintages, both run hashes, closed #1310 and every source/physical/legal unknown. New code/evidence only in the owned namespace; bind complete48candidate/9family/16contact scope and immutable whole inputs. Missing/duplicate/foreign/wrong-identity inputs must fail.
- Derive report counts from complete input records and reconcile frozen scope/source claims before publication. Reject false required controls, contradictory counts/rosters and wrong run/code bindings. Passed receipts must reflect actual successful checks and complete emitted products; equality alone cannot establish validity.
- Publish an additive erratum for six versus four and contact-method wording, bound to original full runs. Preserve original11/24/11/2 and42/8/34/6 results when consuming intact reports. Do not reinterpret unknowns as geography approval.
- Admit the full fresh output set and all ancestors before writes. Reject occupied files/directories, live/dangling symlinks, unsafe ancestors and escaped paths. Use exclusive creation; preserve sentinels/targets on collisions and partial-write failures. Completion receipt is last. No in-place regeneration of retained evidence.
- Run the real new report CLI twice using complete original reports; independently derive metrics/joins and exercise real false-control/count, omission/duplicate/foreign, run-mismatch, ordinary/broken/live symlink and partial-write cases. Record actual failures honestly. This bounded reporting task promises no new national geometry or physical observations.

Inspected evidence: all21 whole changed originals/modes match head/merge (6,349,705 bytes). All71 complete encoded baseline pins authenticated (83,667,735 bytes). Complete original France source decodes to6,755,489 bytes with320 unique native shapes. All16 full source/Atlas contacts match their authenticated complete original bodies. All48 retained geometry hashes/family/route/admin bindings reconcile across nine families. Final run bytes match. All four actual script executions preserve originals and tracked repository content. CI/review receipts are examined historical evidence, not independent scientific certification.

Deduplication: authenticated all-state issue/PR pagination exhausted15 pages (14x100+88 entries); original #1310 and parent #1202 reviewed, no scoped reporting repair found. Complete namespace history contains only1329, and both current open PR file lists were exhausted. Other French regional packets and country repairs have distinct owned paths. Initially blocked pending shared readiness/dependency/ownership review. Auditor takes no implementation claim.

Limits: whole IGN source156,850,437 bytes exceeds32MiB. Whole component/family/admin routing bodies208,391,779/111,223,285/68,041,008 bytes also exceed it. Declared raw+decoded baseline plus external body already636,660,033 bytes exceeds256MiB. Full producer not executed; no fragment/streaming waiver, legal/reuse/geography/import/publication approval. Repairing reports does not certify those unexecuted scientific operations.
